locators.section: 2.4 The linear sieve with well-factorable coefficients

source_observations: Lemma 3.5 is uniform for |a|<=X and requires beta_n to satisfy (3.2) and a small-prime-factor exclusion.
The paper explicitly invokes Lemma 3.5 for the low-p1 part of G9 but does not display the alpha/beta dyadic decomposition.
The displayed G11 and G12 estimates are introduced by 'Similarly as before' without a per-block Lemma 3.5 mapping.
cannot_imply: The existence of the cited lemma does not verify any particular application.
Missing exposition does not by itself prove that an application is false.
An arXiv version lock does not constitute peer review or independent proof verification.
The absent source-byte hash prevents a byte-level source-integrity claim.
